**Visual configuration / comparison**
Layout, palette, finish, image count/size, rotation interval and duration tested. Compare with solid cards and no background using the same apps/settings. Note whether sluggishness remains outside Home.

Follow [the test procedure](https://github.com/mbsintegrations/LG-TV-HA-Home-Launcher/blob/main/docs/TV-TESTING.md). Share only sanitized evidence; no HA tokens, pairing keys, private IPKs, personal photos or household profiles.
